data.text:
Financial Officer- Sri Pramod Kumar ... vs The Union Of India
And 2 Ors on 24 April, 2024 
Author: Kalyan Rai Surana Bench: Kalyan Rai Surana  Page No.# 1/3 GAHC010144392020  THE GAUHATI HIGH COURT  (HIGH COURT OF ASSAM, NAGALAND, MIZORAM AND ARUNACHAL PRADESH)
 Case No. : WP(C)/4316/2020  RSH AGRO PRODUCTS LIMITED  CIN NO. U15132AS2021PLC012193, REPRESENTED BY ITS CHIEF  FINANCIAL OFFICER- SRI PRAMOD KUMAR CHOUDHURY, HAVING ITS  REGISTERED OFFICE AT- VILLAGE AMBHER, 12TH MILE, JORABAT,
 GUWAHATI-781023, KAMRUP(M), ASSAM  VERSUS  THE UNION OF INDIA AND 2 ORS.
 REPRESENTED BY THE SECRETARY, MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND FAMILY  WELFARE, GOVERNMENT OF INDIA, FOOD REGULATION SECTION,
 NIRMAN BHAWAN, NEW DELHI-110011  2: FOOD SAFETY AND STANDARDS AUTHORITY OF INDIA  ( A STATUTORY AUTHORITY ESTABLISHED UNDER THE FOOD SAFETY  AND STANDARDS ACT  2006 INDIA) REPRESENTED BY ITS AUTHORIZED  REPRESENTATIVE/ADVISOR  FDA BHAWAN  KOLTA ROAD  NEW DELHI-110002  3:COMMISSIONER OF FOOD SAFETY  HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE DEPARTMENT  ASSAM SECRETARIAT  BLOCK-D  4TH FLOOR  DISPUR-781006  ASSA Financial Officer- Sri Pramod Kumar ... vs The Union Of India And 2 Ors on 24 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131986883/
1 Advocate for the Petitioner : MR D K DAS Advocate for the Respondent : ASSTT.S.G.I.
 Page No.# 2/3  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KALYAN RAI SURANA  ORDER Date : 24.04.2024 Mr. R. K. Agarwal, learned counsel for the petitioner is present. He submits that in view of Section 35(k) of the IBC 2016 as well as in light of order dated 18.12.2023 passed by the NCLT, Guwahati bench in I.A. (I.B.C.)/3/GB/2023 in C.P.(I.B.)/18/GB/2021, he is under legal bar to appear for the petitioner in this case. The said submission is recorded. 
2. Mr. B. Chakravarty, learned CGC appearing for the respondent no.1 has submitted that he is in receipt of instruction dated 12.01.2021 by the Under Secretary to the Govt. of India, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Department of Health & Family Welfare (Food Regulation Section), that the order impugned in this writ petition has been withdrawn in view of the orders passed by the High Court of Delhi in WP(C) 8834/2020 and other connected matters.
3. The learned CGC has provided photocopies thereof to be retained in record.
4. In view of the submissions is made by the learned CGC, the matter has become infructuous. 
Page No.# 3/3 5. Accordingly, this matter stands closed having been rendered infructuous.
